definitions.explanation: To remove clothing or footwear from one's body.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。
コートを{脱|ぬ}ぎましょうか？
examples.english: Shall I take off my coat?

examples.japanese: {帽子|ぼうし}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{脱|ぬ}ぐ (take off X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {脱|ぬ}いでいる = 'has taken off' (is now without).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}ぐ (take off shoes)
・{服|ふく}を{脱|ぬ}ぐ (take off clothes)
・{帽子|ぼうし}を{脱|ぬ}ぐ (take off hat)
・{脱|ぬ}いでください (please take off)

Used for all clothing types. Opposite verbs: {着|き}る (upper body), {履|は}く (legs/feet), かぶる (head).
